✅ Why a Variance ≈ 1 Is Normal Here
1️⃣ The data is already normalized

The neural features in Brain-to-Text datasets are z-scored:

Mean ≈ 0

Variance ≈ 1

This normalization is typically done:

Per channel

Across time and trials

Purpose:

Remove electrode-specific scale differences

Stabilize neural network training

📌 So seeing variance ≈ 1 across almost all channels is expected.

From your analysis:

Mean neural activity ≈ 0

Standard deviation ≈ 1

Consistent across:

Sessions

Train / validation / test splits

➡️ This indicates:

No data leakage

No session bias

No scaling errors

| Band           | Frequency     | Role in Speech                         |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| **High-gamma** | **70–200 Hz** | Most predictive of speech articulation |
| Beta           | 13–30 Hz      | Motor planning & inhibition            |
| Low-gamma      | 30–70 Hz      | Phoneme transitions                    |
| Theta          | 4–8 Hz        | Syllabic timing                        |
| Alpha          | 8–12 Hz       | Often suppressed during speech         |
